We are recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Senior Solution Sales Executive - Business AI Platform

Requisition ID: 458090
Job Location: Lagos

What You&#39;ll Build&nbsp;


	You will build a focused BAIP sales motion across Emerging Africa, independently mapping customer strategic priorities to SAP Business AI platform &mdash; including Joule, embedded AI use cases across SAP&rsquo;s application portfolio, and the SAP AI Foundation on Business Technology Platform and Business Data Cloud.
	You will partner with account executives, solution advisors, and ecosystem partners to run value-led AI sales plays, generate net-new pipeline, and orchestrate proof-of-value engagements that drive bookings and adoption.
	The role is accountable for cloud revenue growth in the Business AI Platform portfolio. You will serve as the primary BAIP domain sales specialist for your territory &mdash; qualifying and advancing AI-specific opportunities, supporting renewals and expansions with outcome-based narratives, and fostering the long-term customer relationships that underpin successful AI adoption at scale.
	You will engage C-level and line-of-business stakeholders, articulating a clear path from initial AI use case to enterprise-wide Joule agentic workflows &mdash; partnering with the broader account team and local partner ecosystem to build pipeline, drive bookings, and realise customer lifetime value


Where You Belong&nbsp;


	At SAP, you will be part of a growing community of Business AI Platform Line of Business solutions sales professionals across Emerging Africa, dedicated to bringing the power of enterprise AI.
	Our team operates at the forefront of SAP&rsquo;s strategic priority &mdash; Business AI &mdash; and we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive sales culture where deep domain knowledge, customer empathy, and commercial excellence combine.
	Emerging Africa represents one of SAP&rsquo;s key growth markets on the continent. You will be supported by regional leadership, a collaborative partner ecosystem, and SAP&rsquo;s global AI product innovation engine &mdash; giving you everything you need to lead credible, impactful AI conversations with the region&rsquo;s most forward-looking enterprises.


What You&#39;ll Bring&nbsp;


	Bring your ability to independently understand enterprise and corporate customer ambitions in one of Africa&#39;s most dynamic economies, articulate how SAP&#39;s Business AI Platform (BAIP) accelerate those outcomes, and act as a trusted domain expert who drives AI-specific sales motions, builds a healthy pipeline, and delivers measurable customer value.
	You are comfortable operating at the intersection of business transformation and AI adoption &mdash; translating complex AI capabilities into tangible ROI for Nigerian and Emerging Africa customers.

Senior Solution Sales Executive - Business AI Platform Job at SAP




        
    

        
        SAP started in 1972 as a team of five colleagues with a desire to do something new. Together, they changed enterprise software and reinvented how business was done. Today, as a market leader in enterprise application software, we remain true to our roots. That’s why we engineer solutions to fuel innovation, foster equality and spread opportunity for our employees and customers across borders and cultures.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Senior Solution Sales Executive - Business AI Platform

Requisition ID: 458090
Job Location: Lagos

What You'll Build 
     

            
    




	You will build a focused BAIP sales motion across Emerging Africa, independently mapping customer strategic priorities to SAP Business AI platform — including Joule, embedded AI use cases across SAP’s application portfolio, and the SAP AI Foundation on Business Technology Platform and Business Data Cloud.
	You will partner with account executives, solution advisors, and ecosystem partners to run value-led AI sales plays, generate net-new pipeline, and orchestrate proof-of-value engagements that drive bookings and adoption.
	The role is accountable for cloud revenue growth in the Business AI Platform portfolio. You will serve as the primary BAIP domain sales specialist for your territory — qualifying and advancing AI-specific opportunities, supporting renewals and expansions with outcome-based narratives, and fostering the long-term customer relationships that underpin successful AI adoption at scale.
	You will engage C-level and line-of-business stakeholders, articulating a clear path from initial AI use case to enterprise-wide Joule agentic workflows — partnering with the broader account team and local partner ecosystem to build pipeline, drive bookings, and realise customer lifetime value


Where You Belong 


	At SAP, you will be part of a growing community of Business AI Platform Line of Business solutions sales professionals across Emerging Africa, dedicated to bringing the power of enterprise AI.
	Our team operates at the forefront of SAP’s strategic priority — Business AI — and we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive sales culture where deep domain knowledge, customer empathy, and commercial excellence combine.
	Emerging Africa represents one of SAP’s key growth markets on the continent. You will be supported by regional leadership, a collaborative partner ecosystem, and SAP’s global AI product innovation engine — giving you everything you need to lead credible, impactful AI conversations with the region’s most forward-looking enterprises.


What You'll Bring 


	Bring your ability to independently understand enterprise and corporate customer ambitions in one of Africa's most dynamic economies, articulate how SAP's Business AI Platform (BAIP) accelerate those outcomes, and act as a trusted domain expert who drives AI-specific sales motions, builds a healthy pipeline, and delivers measurable customer value.
	You are comfortable operating at the intersection of business transformation and AI adoption — translating complex AI capabilities into tangible ROI for Nigerian and Emerging Africa customers.


Skills:


	Customer Value Proposition
	Technology Solution Adoption
	Customer Engagement
	Account Strategy
	Net New Sales
	Solution Selling
	Demand Generation
	Selling Techniques
	Competitive Positioning
	Negotiation
	Demonstration Skills
	Industry Analysis
	Overcoming Objections
	Sales Territory Management
	Relationship Building
	AI Value Selling
	Strategic AI Synthesis
	Data-Driven Stakeholder Engagement
	Context Engineering
	AI Output Quality Assurance
	Agentic AI Day-to-Day Practice
	AI-Assisted Automation and Prototyping
	AI Adoption Capability

Customer Sales Associate Job at Vitel Wireless Limited




        
    

        
        Vitel Wireless Limited is a telecommunications company and a licensed Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in Nigeria. We provide reliable voice, data, and SMS services nationwide. Driven by innovation and a commitment to quality service, we are focused on expanding connectivity and delivering exceptionaltelecom solutions across Nigeria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Sales Associate

Job Location: Banex Mall - Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking enthusiastic and customer-focused individuals to join our team as Customer Sales Associates at our retail outlets.


Key Responsibilities


	Drive sales of SIM cards, MiFi devices, and routers.
	Attend to walk-in customers, understand their needs, and recommend suitable products and services.
	Promote Vitel Wireless products and convert customer enquiries into sales.
	Process SIM registrations and activations accurately in line with company procedures.
	Achieve assigned sales targets and maintain accurate sales and activation records.
	Provide feedback on customer needs, product demand, and sales performance.


Qualifications & Requirements


	OND, HND, or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Mass Communication, or a related field.
	1–2 years of experience in sales, retail, telecommunications, or customer service is an advantage.
	Strong communication, interpersonal, customer service, and sales skills.
	Confident, persuasive, and customer-focused with the ability to engage customers effectively.
	Ability to meet sales targets and demonstrate a proactive, energetic, and results-oriented approach.
	Professional appearance, strong work ethic, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced telecommunications environment.


What We Offer


	N130,000 – N150,000 monthly salary.
	Commission on SIM card sales.
	Professional and supportive work environment.
	Opportunities for learning and professional development.
	Opportunity to build experience in the telecommunications industry.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using “Application – Customer Sales Associate” as the subject of the mail.

QA / QC Engineer - Piling & Structural Works Job at Hitech Construction Company Limited




        
    

        
        Established in 1988, Hitech Construction Company Limited is currently one of the leading Building & Civil Engineering Contractors in Nigeria. In addition to headquarters offices in Lagos, we have regional offices located in Abuja, Ibadan and Benin City.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: QA / QC Engineer - Piling & Structural Works

Job Location: Nigeria

Job Description


	We are seeking an experienced QA/QC Engineer with strong experience in piling and structural works to ensure quality standards are maintained across construction activities.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Implement and monitor QA/QC procedures for pile foundations, piers, pier caps, precast segments, and station buildings.
	Conduct inspections and quality checks to ensure works comply with approved drawings, specifications, and standards.
	Review method statements, ITPs, test reports, and other quality documentation.
	Monitor materials, workmanship, and testing activities throughout project execution.
	Identify non-conformities and follow up on corrective actions.
	Coordinate with site engineers, subcontractors, and project teams to maintain required quality standards.


Requirements


	Degree in Civil Engineering or related field.
	Proven QA/QC experience in piling and major structural works.
	Practical experience with pile foundations, piers, pier caps, precast segments, and station buildings is essential.
	Strong knowledge of construction inspection, testing, and quality control procedures.
	Good attention to detail and ability to work effectively in a site-based environment.


Method of Applictaion

title: Job Openings at Dwellion DesignDwellion Design
content:
Dwellion Design was founded in 2017, we have been motivated by a desire to better serve our clients and work closely with our clients to create personalized, stress-free design experiences, helping families and businesses express themselves through their unique spaces

Dwellion Design delivers strategic interior design planning and environmental branding to transform hotels, restaurants, luxury multi-family properties, retail, commercial spaces, and more.

We always begin with you, your interests, and your requirements.Then we consider the ideal project to bring your ideal new house to life.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Professional Driver
     

            
    



Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities


	Safely operate and maintain company vehicles in compliance with local and international traffic regulations.
	Transport goods, equipment, and personnel to and from specified locations in a timely and efficient manner.
	Perform vehicle inspections and basic maintenance, reporting any issues promptly.
	Plan and follow the most efficient routes for each trip to ensure on-time delivery.
	Load and unload goods or equipment as needed, ensuring their safe handling and secure storage.
	Provide a high level of customer service and professionalism when interacting with clients and colleagues.
	Keep accurate records of mileage, fuel consumption, and vehicle maintenance.
	Adhere to safety protocols and emergency procedures, including first aid and crisis response.
	Maintain cleanliness and orderliness of company vehicles.
	Ensure that all required vehicle documents, such as licenses, insurance, and registration, are up to date and valid.
	Assist in the organization of transportation schedules and coordination with logistics teams.
	Report any accidents, injuries, or traffic violations and cooperate with company and law enforcement authorities.
	Follow company policies and guidelines on vehicle use and code of conduct.
	Collaborate with logistics and supply chain teams to optimize transportation procedures.
	Stay updated on local traffic and road conditions that may affect transportation schedules.


Qualifications


	Interested candidates should possess an SSCE / GCE / NECO with 5 - 7 years of experience.


Application Closing Date: 10th October, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

 

2.)  Project Manager

Job Location: Chevron-Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilties


	Prepare and review structural designs and calculations for buildings and civil works.
	Interpret architectural drawings and convert them into structural engineering designs.
	Develop structural drawings for foundations, beams, slabs, columns, and reinforcement detailing.
	Prepare detailed Bills of Quantities (BOQ) based on architectural and engineering drawings.
	Support procurement by preparing material specifications and quantity requirements.
	Review supplier and subcontractor quotations against BOQ specifications.
	Track project expenditures and provide cost performance reports.
	Oversee site teams including engineers, supervisors, and subcontractors.
	Ensure adherence to project schedules and productivity targets.
	Ensure all project activities meet company quality standards and industry regulations.
	Enforce health and safety policies on all project sites.
	Conduct risk assessments and ensure mitigation measures are implemented.
	Prepare and present technical and operational project progress reports to management.
	Coordinate with architects, engineers, consultants, and clients.
	Track key performance indicators related to cost, schedule, and quality.
	Provide regular updates on project status, risks, and mitigation plans.


Qualifications


	Interested candidates should possess a Bachelor`s Degree with 5 - 7 years of experience.


Application Closing Date: 15th October, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Portfolio to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

3.) Driver

Job Location: Chevron-Lekki, Lagos

Responsibilties


	Safely operate and maintain company vehicles in compliance with local and international traffic regulations.
	Transport goods, equipment, and personnel to and from specified locations in a timely and efficient manner.
	Perform vehicle inspections and basic maintenance, reporting any issues promptly.
	Plan and follow the most efficient routes for each trip to ensure on-time delivery.
	Load and unload goods or equipment as needed, ensuring their safe handling and secure storage.
	Provide a high level of customer service and professionalism when interacting with clients and colleagues.
	Keep accurate records of mileage, fuel consumption, and vehicle maintenance.
	Adhere to safety protocols and emergency procedures, including first aid and crisis response.
	Maintain cleanliness and orderliness of company vehicles.
	Ensure that all required vehicle documents, such as licenses, insurance, and registration, are up to date and valid.
	Assist in the organization of transportation schedules and coordination with logistics teams.
	Report any accidents, injuries, or traffic violations and cooperate with company and law enforcement authorities.
	Follow company policies and guidelines on vehicle use and code of conduct.
	Collaborate with logistics and supply chain teams to optimize transportation procedures.
	Stay updated on local traffic and road conditions that may affect transportation schedules.


Application Closing Date: 30th September, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Portfolio to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
